items.title: Jensen Huang Has Become World’s 8th Richest Person
items.summary: Jensen Huang turned a modest chip startup into the backbone of the global AI arms race, and his personal fortune now rivals the biggest names in tech. But three mounting challenges could test whether Nvidia's reign at the top is as unshakeable as it appears.

items.title: How Nvidia Tried to Profit Twice From Every Chip Sale—and Why It Backfired
items.summary: Nvidia announced a program to collect revenue on the same chip twice, once at sale and again through ongoing cloud profits, then paused it weeks later after internal warnings about antitrust exposure. The retreat raises a question the market has not priced in.
